findings.title: AI tool layer not production-wired
findings.observation: AiToolExecutor and AiToolStepUpService exist with solid unit/architecture tests, but no src/** import constructs/registers/executes tools outside toolLayer.ts itself. aiHandler does not call the executor.
findings.impact: Masterplan AI tool side-effect boundary is library-only; product cannot exercise authorized tools end-to-end. Risk of false VERIFIED if stages accept tests as runtime proof.
findings.repro: rg -n "AiToolExecutor|from ['\"].*toolLayer" src tests — only toolLayer + tests hit.
findings.fixNeed: Trusted integration layer registering tools + wiring from interaction/dashboard confirmation; regression e2e that mutating tool without step-up never hits handler.

findings.title: Dev IP allowlist fail-open when empty
findings.observation: auth middleware documents empty IpList(WHITELIST) as fail-open for DEV.
findings.impact: Misconfigured prod DEV access may rely only on password/session without network restriction.
findings.repro: Read requireDev IP allowlist comments/behavior with empty env list.
findings.fixNeed: Fail-closed default in production or explicit audited exception + config checklist.

findings.title: Nitrado runtime init is warn-only
findings.observation: index.ts catches startNitradoRuntime errors and continues; dashboard failure aborts process.
findings.impact: Process can appear healthy while whitelist/ban/ADM/job consumers never start → silent side-effect loss.
findings.repro: Force startNitradoRuntime throw; observe bot continues after warn.
findings.fixNeed: Fail-fast or readiness degradation signal when nitrado runtime down; health/ready coupling.

findings.title: AI background loops best-effort
findings.observation: startAiBackgroundLoops logs warnings for guild awareness, embeddings, conversation memory, translated posts without failing boot.
findings.impact: RAG/translate/awareness may be off without operator-facing hard fail.
findings.fixNeed: Metrics + readiness flags for AI subsystem health; document acceptable degradation.

findings.title: Orphan EnterpriseStub component
findings.observation: dashboard-ui EnterpriseStub has no import sites.

findings.title: Residual _ToolStub while catalog all ready
findings.observation: devToolsCatalog marks every tool status ready; _ToolStub.tsx remains.
findings.impact: UI metadata may overclaim readiness for analysis tools until per-page audit.
findings.fixNeed: Per-slug backend verification in dashboard stages; align catalog status.

findings.title: /test admin surface mounted in production server
findings.observation: testRouter at /test allows ADMIN/DEVELOPER session to read cross-tenant db-stats and mutate feature toggles; intentional Stage-64 eslint exception for unscoped prisma.
findings.impact: Broad diagnostic/mutation API if role compromised; not guild-scoped.
findings.fixNeed: Confirm prod exposure policy; tighten to bot-admin/dev session parity or disable in production.

findings.title: devStubs routes are mounted live diagnostics
findings.observation: Named stubs but mounted behind GlobalDev+DevSession+step-up; not orphan routes.
findings.impact: Naming confusion only unless handlers fake data — content audit later.
findings.fixNeed: None unless data faked; rename optional.

findings.title: DEV tools catalog ready ≠ verified product
findings.observation: All DEV_TOOLS entries use status ready without this step validating ADM analysis backends.
findings.impact: Risk of stage greenwashing from UI labels.
findings.fixNeed: Stage matrix must require API+DB evidence per tool.

findings.title: CI Test job couples DB lifecycle to jest
findings.observation: ci.yml runs migrate deploy/status, db:consistency, db:lifecycle before tests with Postgres service and secrets env — local test:ci often lacks this.
findings.impact: Supports root-cause for F-PRE-01 local vs CI divergence (env/matrix), not proof tests are perfect.
findings.fixNeed: Document required local env parity or composite npm script mirroring CI.
